cards.target: Quem estuda passa.
cards.english: Those who study pass.

cards.target: Nós tínhamos esperado por horas.
cards.english: We had waited for hours.

cards.target: Tudo que ele disse é verdade.
cards.english: Everything he said is true.

cards.target: Eu tenho corrido todas as manhãs.
cards.english: I've been running every morning.

cards.target: Eu tenho sentido saudade da minha família.
cards.english: I've been missing my family.

cards.target: Ela tem trabalhado demais ultimamente.
cards.english: She's been working too much lately.

cards.target: Gosto de pessoas que são sinceras.
cards.english: I like people who are sincere.

cards.target: Tudo que acontece tem um motivo.
cards.english: Everything that happens has a reason.

cards.target: Eu tinha esquecido de comprar leite.
cards.english: I had forgotten to buy milk.

cards.target: Eu tenho tentado comer mais saudável.
cards.english: I've been trying to eat more healthily.

cards.target: As coisas têm ficado mais caras.
cards.english: Things have been getting more expensive.

cards.target: Eu tenho cozinhado mais em casa.
cards.english: I've been cooking more at home.

cards.target: A tecnologia tem avançado muito rápido.
cards.english: Technology has been advancing very quickly.

cards.target: O carro que eu aluguei é automático.
cards.english: The car I rented is automatic.

cards.target: A série que estou assistindo é viciante.
cards.english: The series I'm watching is addictive.

cards.target: Os pratos que ela preparou estavam deliciosos.
cards.english: The dishes she prepared were delicious.

cards.target: Eles tinham se mudado para outra cidade.
cards.english: They had moved to another city.

cards.target: A gente tem se comunicado por videochamada.
cards.english: We've been communicating by video call.

cards.target: A gente tinha passado por dificuldades financeiras.
cards.english: We had gone through financial difficulties.

cards.target: O apartamento que a gente visitou é espaçoso.
cards.english: The apartment we visited is spacious.

cards.target: O dia em que nos conhecemos foi especial.
cards.english: The day we met was special.

cards.target: Ele falou como se soubesse tudo.
cards.english: He spoke as if he knew everything.

cards.target: Se eu tivesse paciência, ensinaria crianças.
cards.english: If I had patience, I would teach children.

cards.target: Sabe-se que o problema é antigo.
cards.english: It's known that the problem is old.

cards.target: A escola onde estudei fica no centro.
cards.english: The school where I studied is downtown.

cards.target: As pessoas que trabalham aqui são dedicadas.
cards.english: The people who work here are dedicated.

cards.target: Os documentos que você pediu estão prontos.
cards.english: The documents you asked for are ready.

cards.target: A empresa onde ele estagiou o contratou.
cards.english: The company where he interned hired him.

cards.target: Ela já tinha ido embora quando cheguei.
cards.english: She had already left when I arrived.

cards.target: Ela tinha coberto o bolo com chocolate.
cards.english: She had covered the cake with chocolate.

cards.target: Eu tenho aprendido coisas novas no trabalho.
cards.english: I've been learning new things at work.

cards.target: Eu já tinha contado essa história antes.
cards.english: I had already told this story before.

cards.target: Eu tenho saído mais com os amigos.
cards.english: I've been going out more with friends.

cards.target: Nós tínhamos comprado os ingressos com antecedência.
cards.english: We had bought the tickets in advance.

cards.target: Quem dera eu pudesse tirar férias agora.
cards.english: If only I could take vacation now.

cards.target: As flores que você me deu são lindas.
cards.english: The flowers you gave me are beautiful.

cards.target: A música que está tocando é minha favorita.
cards.english: The song that's playing is my favorite.

cards.target: O projeto no qual estamos trabalhando é complexo.
cards.english: The project we're working on is complex.

cards.target: O assunto sobre o qual conversamos é delicado.
cards.english: The topic we talked about is sensitive.

cards.target: Nós tínhamos combinado de nos encontrar às três.
cards.english: We had agreed to meet at three.

cards.target: Nós tínhamos pagado a conta antes de sair.
cards.english: We had paid the bill before leaving.

cards.target: A gente tinha marcado uma consulta para hoje.
cards.english: We had scheduled an appointment for today.

cards.target: A gente tem economizado para comprar um carro.
cards.english: We've been saving to buy a car.

cards.target: Ela tem cuidado bem das plantas.
cards.english: She's been taking good care of the plants.

cards.target: Eu tenho procurado emprego desde janeiro.
cards.english: I've been looking for a job since January.

cards.target: Eu tinha imprimido os documentos de manhã.
cards.english: I had printed the documents in the morning.

cards.target: Ela tinha devolvido o livro na biblioteca.
cards.english: She had returned the book to the library.

cards.target: O time tem jogado bem nesta temporada.
cards.english: The team has been playing well this season.

cards.target: Se não fosse tão caro, eu compraria.
cards.english: If it weren't so expensive, I'd buy it.

cards.target: Era importante que todos soubessem a notícia.
cards.english: It was important that everyone knew the news.

cards.target: O problema que temos é falta de comunicação.
cards.english: The problem we have is lack of communication.

cards.target: O bolo que ela fez derreteu na boca.
cards.english: The cake she made melted in the mouth.

cards.target: A situação em que nos encontramos é complicada.
cards.english: The situation we find ourselves in is complicated.

cards.target: A gente tinha combinado um almoço, mas cancelaram.
cards.english: We had arranged a lunch, but they canceled.

cards.target: Eu tinha lavado o carro antes da chuva.
cards.english: I had washed the car before the rain.

cards.target: Ela tinha se arrumado quando cancelaram o jantar.
cards.english: She had gotten ready when they canceled dinner.

cards.target: Ela tinha se oferecido para ajudar na organização.
cards.english: She had volunteered to help with the organization.

cards.target: Se a gente tivesse mais dinheiro, viajaríamos mais.
cards.english: If we had more money, we'd travel more.

cards.target: Eles tinham viajado para o exterior pela primeira vez.
cards.english: They had traveled abroad for the first time.

cards.target: Ele tinha descoberto a verdade antes de todo mundo.
cards.english: He had discovered the truth before everyone else.

existing_tips: Impersonal 'se' – no specific subject, describes general experience.
Popular Brazilian saying meaning you make do with what you have.
'Como' can function as a relative pronoun meaning 'the way in which'.
